_about: Coverage settings for every package (OPS-09). The minimums are today's real numbers, rounded down. Raise them when coverage rises; never lower one to make CI pass. A file that cannot sensibly be covered is excluded below with a reason, not hidden by a lower minimum.

exclude.reason: Test files are the measuring stick, not the thing measured.
Test helpers (fakes, token signers) exist only to support tests.
Type declarations have no code to run.
Integration test set-up files, such as the Postgres container starter.
The browser entry point only mounts the app. The end-to-end tests cover it.
